import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()

    # De-duplicate reference tables on their natural keys, keeping first occurrence
    ref_customers = ref_customers.drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="first")
    ref_skus = ref_skus.drop_duplicates(subset="sku", keep="first")

    cust_status_map = ref_customers.set_index("customer_id")["status"]
    sku_disc_map = ref_skus.set_index("sku")["discontinued"]
    sku_countries_map = ref_skus.set_index("sku")["allowed_countries"]

    def classify(row):
        cid = row["customer_id"]
        if cid not in cust_status_map.index:
            return "CUST_UNKNOWN"

        status = cust_status_map.loc[cid]
        if status != "ACTIVE":
            return "CUST_INACTIVE"

        sku = row["sku"]
        if sku not in sku_disc_map.index:
            return "SKU_UNKNOWN"

        discontinued = sku_disc_map.loc[sku]
        if pd.notna(discontinued) and int(discontinued) == 1:
            return "SKU_DISC"

        allowed_raw = sku_countries_map.loc[sku]
        if pd.isna(allowed_raw):
            allowed_raw = ""
        allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in str(allowed_raw).split(",") if c.strip() != ""]

        if len(allowed_list) > 0:
            ship_country = row["ship_country"]
            if ship_country not in allowed_list:
                return "CTRY_BLOCKED"

        return None

    orders["reason_code"] = orders.apply(classify, axis=1)

    clean_mask = orders["reason_code"].isna()
    orders_clean = orders[clean_mask].drop(columns=["reason_code"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    orders_rejects = orders[~clean_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects,
    }
